id: DID YOU GET THE MEMO? [New York Times, Sunday, June 15, 2008]

metadata.title: DID YOU GET THE MEMO? [New York Times, Sunday, June 15, 2008]
metadata.author: Jeremy Newton

entries.clue: Fourth members of a musical group
Candy bar whose name is an exclamation
It may be used for banking
What some shoot in a golf round
Drop from the invitation list, say
An essay may be on one
Memo about where tariffs are imposed on incoming ships?
Memo about stores for animal appendages?
Where Forrest Gump did a tour
Memo about a religious outpost for prisoners?
How a ringtone may be set
Memo about why to buy an air purifier?
Ready to roll? ... or not ready to roll?
